candidate_sentences.text: Consolidated revenue for the twelve-month period reached 1.837 billion euros, compared to 1.372 billion euros in the previous year, with the increase largely reflecting the full-year consolidation of Tallink Grupp following its acquisition in August 2024.
Group EBITDA grew significantly to 232.581 million euros, up from 145.415 million euros in 2024, supported by improved profitability in the energy segment and broader business contributions.
However, net profit for the financial year decreased to 71.969 million euros from 193.670 million euros reported in the previous year.
This decline was primarily attributable to one-off effects and initial consolidation gains related to Tallink Grupp recognized during 2024.

verified_key_information_units.information: Energy segment increased sales volumes by 7% to 4.8 TWh in Q4 despite lower regional consumption; Elenger secured a multi-year LNG supply agreement for 12 cargoes and expanded battery storage capacity in Latvia while planning further developments in Estonia.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Events in Q4 2025 section details Elenger sales volume increase, LNG agreement, and battery storage commissions/construction; Management Report describes regional consumption decline and seasonality.

details.coherence_justification: The candidate summary is internally coherent. There are no self-contradictions: all statements align logically (e.g., revenue growth from Tallink acquisition explains higher EBITDA but lower net profit due to one-off gains in prior year). Explanations for changes (revenue growth, EBITDA margin improvement, net profit decline) are clear and mutually supportive. The organization flows logically from consolidated performance to segment results and financial position. There is no unnecessary repetition. Differences between segment and consolidated figures are not contradictions because the summary explicitly attributes changes to acquisition consolidation and one-off effects without implying exhaustive additivity of components.
